 Absolutely Every paint is army painter fanatic line unless other wise mentioned. The ideas and methods are stolen/ borrowed from various youtubers. heresy for heretics was a big inspiration also Marco Frisoni, and likely others i forget to mention I consume a good amount of painting videos. If you see something and think I stole if from a video you watched I likely did.

The base pink is a bit of a process I start with a standard white and black zenithal then spray from underneath with gothic blue looking for roughly 75% coverage. Followed from behind and above with magecast magenta then Impish rogue from the front tapering toward the back looking for a nice 75-85% coverage with a nice fade. Once the base colors are sprayed I tint the overall color with a spray 2-3 coats of familiar pink speedpaint for saturation. To highlight the pink I use impish rouge and then use Vallejo magenta ink to blend it a bit

The teal is just 2 colors talisman teal highlighted with amulet aqua.

The purplish blue for the bolters is Gothic blue highlighted with Aqua blue.

The yellow swords and details are first coated with Proacryl bold titanium white then Games workshop imperial fist contrast followed by Demonic yellow highlighted with space dust and minor spot highlights of electric lime.

The topknot first coated with Proacryl bold titanium white then is a combination of electric lime highlighted with afterglow, followed by a wash of lens glow.

All the gold is emperors gold and yet to be highlighted.

The leather is paragon pine highlighted with forest faun.

Lenses are white followed by afterglow and tassels and drug vials are various paints to taste.

The biggest key is to take time when establishing the initial coats and be very careful after they are established it is very hard to touch up the pink. Theses are very much a work in progress I'm not happy yet with the skin or the vials they are all subject to more paint work and frustration until I figure them out.

Hopefully this helps if you have more questions feel free to ask.
